correctness.rationale: Derive c_k=c_-k c_2k by direct basis multiplication. Character support is a union of finite <-1,2> orbits; multiplying the k and -k equations forces c_k c_-k=1 on support, hence c_2k=c_k^2. All orbits are parametrized by either (2^(d/2)+1)-roots or (2^d-1)-roots according to whether -1 is a power of 2. The field F_q descent condition c_{qk}=c_k^q gives cycles of s_r orbits with exactly gcd(N_r,q^{s_r}-epsilon_r 2^{a_r}) nonzero choices; c0 has two values. Invertible Fourier transform (char not dividing n) proves sufficiency and uniqueness. A self-contained direct multiplication enumerator checked fourteen n,q instances independently; no infinite inference is made from them.

value.rationale: The full idempotent set and cardinality are intrinsic natural invariants of a nonassociative quandle algebra, not a narrow arbitrary slice. A uniform divisor-product formula over all odd n and all coprime-characteristic finite fields is not implied by existing integral-idempotent/Peirce results and exposes nontrivial Frobenius-dependent arithmetic: binary-field cases R11 and R15 have 68 and 768 idempotents. The Fourier parametrization gives all elements, supports reproducibility and future extension to other Alexander quandles. Does not claim to classify excluded modular or even-order cases.
